Here's what was implemented:

**Project structure:**
```
TicketClassifier/
├── Controllers/TicketController.cs   # API endpoints
├── Data/tickets.csv                  # Training data
├── Models/TicketData.cs              # ML.NET input/output models
├── Models/TicketRequest.cs           # API DTOs
├── Services/TicketClassifierService.cs # ML pipeline & prediction engine
├── Program.cs                        # DI & app setup
└── TicketClassifier.csproj           # Microsoft.ML 4.0.2 dependency
```

**Endpoints:**
- `POST /api/ticket/predict` — classifies a ticket into Billing, Technical, or General with confidence scores
- `GET /api/ticket/metrics` — returns evaluation metrics (MacroAccuracy, MicroAccuracy, LogLoss, LogLossReduction)

**ML Pipeline:** Text featurization on Subject + Description, concatenated with Priority, trained using SDCA Maximum Entropy multiclass classifier. Uses train/test split (70/30) for evaluation, then retrains on full data for production predictions.

**Note:** The training dataset has only 6 rows, so metrics are low on the test split. With a larger CSV the model will perform significantly better.
